metadata.description: Tetration — repeated exponentiation of engineering automation. Plugins that compound, self-improve, and chain autonomously.

plugins.name: eigen-squared
plugins.description: Autonomous initiative-scale development orchestration with auto-chaining via claude-tasks. Zero-argument pipeline, triplet IDs, language-agnostic, worktree isolation, convergence loops, real-dependencies testing. Runs a full phase autonomously — plan, code, review, fix — until the E2E Testing epic converges.

plugins.name: eigen-lite
plugins.description: Destilated eigen plugin for small initiatives (2-5 features) on existing codebases. Four commands (lite_start, lite_plan, lite_swarm, lite_review) collapse squared's seven-command planning pipeline into a single-pass planner with parallel analyst subagents. Reuses eigen-squared workers via cross-plugin Skill referencing.
